feedback: Judged from the earlier races. Iteration 0 (kp 5.0, kd 0.1, ki 0.0) and iteration 1 (ki 0.6) both ended off_track on all 60 trials per track, with progress 0.04 to 0.125, one line-loss event per run, max_error at about 0.06 m, and steering_oscillation about 0.07. Iteration 1 moved the score by only -0.034, so the integral term was not the lever. This candidate changes one group, the proportional and derivative gains (kp 8.0, kd 0.2, ki 0.0), with geometry and base_speed unchanged. That is a valid, single-group test of the diagnosis that the robot holds a standing offset under weak proportional correction. Scaling kp is equivalent to scaling the sensor weights, since the signal is normalised, so the change is physically sensible. I state no outcome for this candidate. Before the race, note one geometric concern from the contract. The sensors sit at x = 0, ±0.02 and ±0.04 with sensor_size 0.012, and the tape is 25 mm wide. The centre sensor is the only one that reads the tape when the robot is centred, and its weight is 0. So there is a dead band of roughly ±8 mm before the 0.02 m sensors see any tape, and the signal stays near zero there. Next race, read the results as follows. If max_error falls below 0.06 m and line_loss_events drops, keep kp near 8 and move on to base_speed. If steering_oscillation rises above about 0.15, or max_error clusters on the slalom bends, reduce kp to 6.0 and keep kd at 0.2. If the robot tracks the line but completion_time exceeds 3 s, raise base_speed to 1.6. If progress still stalls at the same point with low oscillation, the dead band is the likely cause, so change the sensor geometry (sensor_size 0.016 or outer sensors at x = ±0.06) before touching gains again. Change one group per revision.
requested_changes: If the race shows a standing offset that persists with low oscillation (progress stalls at the same point, steering_oscillation near 0.07), set sensor_size = 0.016 to shrink the dead band around the centre sensor, citing the 0.012 sensor spacing of 0.02 m against the 25 mm tape in the contract.
If steering_oscillation rises above about 0.15 or max_error clusters on the slalom, set kp = 6.0 and keep kd = 0.2, citing the iteration 0 max_error of about 0.060 m as the level to stay below.
If the robot tracks the line but completion_time exceeds 3 s with no off-track event, set base_speed = 1.6, since the 3 s limit needs an average speed of roughly 1.5 m/s.
